# Sven Ahrens

> One of Europe's top consumer monetization and growth leaders, and still hands-on. Eight years scaling Spotify (most recently Director of Global Growth, where his team drove 60%+ of Spotify's subscriber growth and managed over $1B in subscriptions revenue), former CEO of Yousician (20M+ MAU), founder of Newconic Ventures. Based in Berlin. Open to: fractional, board and advisory work, or the right full-time seat.

Sven helps consumer companies grow. He works across the full funnel: growth, product, monetization, pricing and packaging, user acquisition, retention, internationalization and AI transformation. AI-forward in practice: he ships his own products.

## What he does (ways to engage)

- Lead it: steps in as a full-time, interim or fractional Growth, Product, Regional or Business Unit leader and runs it. Senior leader and player-coach from day one.
- Run the team: takes the team already in place and gets it shipping again: focused, accountable, clear on what moves the business.
- Fire-fighter: drops in where it's burning, diagnoses fast, stops the bleeding, and stays with the team until it holds.
- Board member or observer: the consumer monetization and growth POV on pricing, retention and packaging, the decisions that compound.
- Advisor or sounding board: for founders and seasoned leaders with a hard call to make. Candid, fast, biased toward action. References on request.

## Key facts

- Eight years at Spotify (2016 to 2024), through the hyper-growth era; ended as Director of Global Growth.
- His Spotify Global Growth team drove 60%+ of Spotify's subscriber growth and managed over $1B in subscriptions revenue.
- CEO of Yousician (2025 to 2026), the company behind the music apps Yousician and GuitarTuna, with 20M+ monthly active users.
- Chief Growth Officer at Muse Group (2024); Board Observer at Female Invest (2024 to present).
- Founder of Newconic Ventures (2019 to present): 20+ angel investments in consumer, prosumer, AI and subscription startups across the EU and US. Two exits: Butter (to Miro) and Petli (to Agria). Advisory: Peloton, Knowunity, Kittl.
- Earlier: Consultant at Bain & Company (2012 to 2016), incl. a SoundCloud new-markets externship (2014).
- Based in Berlin. Native German; fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Traveled to 75+ countries.
- Ships his own AI products: trainwithkalle.com and trainingzones.app.

## Works with

Consumer and prosumer companies with growth problems on more than one front (product, monetization, user acquisition, culture, leadership), and companies in the middle of an AI transformation. Pre-seed founders to seasoned leadership teams.
